message.reasoning:
We need to generate JUnit 4 test cases to comprehensively test all methods in Document class. Provide a file starting with ###Test START## and ending with ###Test END##. Should include imports, test class, test methods covering constructors, createShell, location, head, body, title getter/setter, createElement, normalise (including moving text nodes, handling multiple heads/bodies, meta charset handling), charset methods, updateMetaCharsetElement flag, outputSettings getter/setter, quirksMode getter/setter, clone, and maybe OutputSettings methods like escapeMode, charset, syntax, prettyPrint, outline, indentAmount, etc.

But we need to write test methods for Document class only; can also test inner OutputSettings.

We need to use Jsoup library classes like Element, TextNode, XmlDeclaration etc. Since the test code will compile, we need to import org.jsoup.nodes.*; org.jsoup.parser.*; etc.

We must consider that Document extends Element, which has many methods; we can rely on existing behavior.

Write tests:

- testCreateShell: ensure html, head, body exist, and that they are children of document.

- testLocation: new Document("http://example.com") location() returns same.

- testHeadBody: after createShell, head() and body() not null and tag names.

- testTitleGetSet: set title via title(String), then get title(); also test that setting when no title element adds to head.

- testCreateElement: createElement with tag "p" returns element with tag name "p" and baseUri same as doc.

- testNormaliseAddsMissingElements: create Document with no html/head/body, add stray text nodes, call normalise, verify structure.

- testNormaliseMergeMultipleHeadsAndBodies: create duplicate head elements with children, ensure merged.

- testNormaliseTextNodeMovement: add TextNode to document directly, after normalise ensure text moved to body.

- testCharsetUpdateMeta: set updateMetaCharsetElement(true), set outputSettings syntax html, call charset(StandardCharsets.ISO_8859_1), verify meta charset element exists with proper charset attribute, and that obsolete meta removed.

- testCharsetXmlDeclaration: set syntax xml, ensure xml declaration added/updated.

- testUpdateMetaCharsetFlag: default false, calling charset without flag should not add meta.

- testOutputSettingsClone: clone document and verify outputSettings not same object but charset same.

- testQuirksMode: set and get.

- testDocumentClone: ensure cloned doc equals but independent.

Also test OutputSettings methods: escapeMode, charset, syntax, prettyPrint, outline, indentAmount validation.

Provide assertions.

Note: Use JUnit 4 @Test, assertEquals, assertNotNull, assertTrue, assertFalse, assertSame, etc.

Make sure to import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.

Write code accordingly.

Now produce final answer.
